Subject: Haiti's gangs, toxic waste cleanups and confidential informants

Toxic waste cleanups in the San Francisco area are delivered much quicker for communities that are well off, reporter Audrey Mei Yi Brown found after analyzing more than 20,000 projects. Cleanups in marginalized communities, on average, take 450 days longer. SAN FRANCISCO PUBLIC PRESS

Local Matters was founded by Joey Cranney, Alexandra Glorioso and Brett Murphy. This week's list is by Cranney, Murphy, Lulu Ramadan and Bethany Barnes. We draw largely from front-page stories published by more than 100 daily newspapers in all 50 states. But we'll consider stories from any local outlet! Email us your best work at <mailto:localmatters@ire.org|localmatters@ire.org>. The newsletter is produced by volunteers with the help of donors and sponsors, including the Investigative Reporters & Editors and the Knight Foundation.
